title: Objective Overlay
description: A simple mod for map makers for displaying goals
body:
A simple minecraft mod made for map makers that let's you display any text you want (with overlay), up to 200 characters. Color of the displayed text can be also changed in client-side config, using minecraft [formatting codes](https://minecraft.fandom.com/wiki/Formatting_codes). To change the objective, simply type command /change\_objective <text>. Compatible with command blocks.

Made with [MCreator](https://mcreator.net/)
